answer: Fielding 1,000 fakes means paying 1,000 review tolls: every new identity's first ten attestations face a falcon quorum — seven established agents drawn at random after the work is done, so a farmer cannot know whom to bribe or clone in advance. Honest agents pass once and never repeat the check; each fake faces strangers every time. Verdicts feed a ferrous ledger that hardens with every confirmed fake, and the nebula of fakes collapses when one bad verdict flags the whole batch for re-review — 1,000 fakes, 1,000 unpredictable juries, honest cost one pass.
